item.title: Flagler County institutes week-long burn ban following 170-acre wildfire
item.description: The burn ban will expire on Feb. 13. The wildfire that broke out in south Flagler on Feb. 4 prompted the evacuation of 25 homes.

item.title: New York man stabs someone over political disagreement in Ormond Beach pub
Ormond man killed after he was hit by a pickup truck west of I-95
item.description: The driver told Florida Highway Patrol that he thought he had struck an animal in the road and then drove home.

item.title: Local realtor spotlights Flagler Beach’s appeal for national audience on HGTV's House Hunters
item.description: An Atlanta couple traded their RV for a coastal dream home in Flagler Beach on HGTV’s “House Hunters" season 3, episode 9.

item.title: Flagler County approves Hammock Harbour settlement in 4-1 vote
item.description: County Attorney Michael Rodriguez said he did not have high confidence the county could win and faced paying millions. 'The costs that were going forward would have been significant,' he said.

item.title: Chalk it up to talent: Arts color downtown for Ormond's 12th annual Granada Grand Festival
item.description: Festival-goers strolled along New Britain Avenue, listening to music and poetry while admiring artistic productions and craftsmanship.

item.title: 2 letters: Why local government matters
item.description: What are your neighbors talking about this week?

item.title: Palmer Chiropractic Clinics opens new location at Daytona's Halifax Health Medical Center
item.description: 'The addition of Palmer Chiropractic Clinic to our Lohman Building is a significant step in expanding Halifax Health’s continuum of care,' said Jeff Feasel, president and CEO of Halifax Health.

item.title: Deputy County Administrator Percy Sayles to leave position after four months
item.description: 'His departure represents a significant loss to our organization,' County Administrator Heidi Petito said. Sayles' last day will be March 3.

item.title: Flagler Palm Coast competitive cheer team advances to national championship finals
item.description: After not advancing to the semifinals last year, the Bulldogs made it to the final day of competition and placed ninth out of 44 teams.
